name: UNDERGROUND22
source:
The Underground King has died. A title that has controlled the United States from the shadows for millennia, a title that in its current state, has no one to claim the throne.

Mia is a young college student, recovering from a mistake that cost them her life as an athlete. Struggling with school, a dwindling social life, and the loss of her athletic abilities, Mia is kidnapped and forced into a game for her life; a game to decide who the next Underground King is.

The underground is a world with no mercy for anyone and has many secrets to hide. Mia must choose her allies and enemies within those kidnapped to reveal the truths shadowed in the depths.

A conspiracy that spans ages - Generations of murder, government, and humanity as a whole.

There are 22 people trapped underground, fighting for a chance to sit on the throne.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2385550/Underground22/]Steam[/url]]
